newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS WINTERTHUR FIRM IN PRE-BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: CS WINTERTHUR FIRM IN PRE-BOURSE.

text.p: Shares of Credit Suisse Group and insurer Winterthur Insurance Co. were firm in pre-bourse trading on the Swiss Exchange in reaction to the planned merger of the two financial groups.
While the initial reaction was positive, traders also said the synergy effects from merging a bank with an insurance company would not be as great as if two banks had merged.
"I am not expecting a Novartis effect," said one dealer, referring to last year's merger of Ciba-Geigy and Sandoz.
"On first view it looks good," said one dealer, noting it would not have been the same if two banks had merger.
"Then the merger effects would have been larger than the 300 million that is estimated," the dealer added.
After initial jump in the shares of both companies -- at their height the shares were up four percent -- the shares eased slightly.
Around 0700 GMT Credit Suisse shares were up four Swiss francs at 212/213 francs and Winterthur up 37.5 francs at 1,545.
Dealers also said warrants by both companies could feel some pressure during the day as they have recently been actively traded on speculation.
"Whoever has warrants will want to cash in now," said one dealer.
